target_description: every generator measured in its own FC grouping and resolved to one common radius; no shared contexts and no elimination

conventions.fc_grouping: deterministic greedy first-fit fully commuting grouping
conventions.pauli_ordering: sort by decreasing Pauli weight, then lexicographic
conventions.tie_breaking: first group that accepts the Pauli string
conventions.note: the grouping is deterministic, so no seed is used
